results.title: Irregular Income Budget Planner, Commission & Tip Tracker (PDF)
results.description:
Tired of budgets that only work if you get the same paycheck every time?

This Irregular Income Budget Planner is made for people whose pay changes every check: tips, commission, gig payouts and freelance work. Find your bare-minimum number, give every paycheck a job, and build a cushion for slow weeks. Budget with confidence even when your paycheck is never the same.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT'S INCLUDED (14 PAGES)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Cover page
• How to Use This Planner (1 simple page)
• Baseline Budget: find your bare-minimum monthly cost
• Paycheck-by-Paycheck Planner: log each check, then assign it (bills → buffer → savings → fun)
• Income Tracker: daily and weekly tips & commission log with a monthly total
• Good Month / Slow Month Plan: what to do with extra money and what to cut when it's slow
• Bill Tracker: due date, amount, paid checkbox
• Buffer Fund Tracker: work toward 1 month of bills saved, with a fill-in progress bar
• Sinking Funds: car repairs, holidays, gifts, insurance, taxes
• Savings Goal Tracker with a 100-square fill-in chart
• Debt Payoff Tracker (snowball or avalanche)
• Tax Set-Aside Tracker for tip, commission and 1099 income
• Monthly Review: best week, slowest week, average income, lessons
• Year-at-a-Glance Income Chart (12 months)

Repeat pages (Paycheck Planner, Income Tracker, Bill Tracker, Monthly Review) can be printed as many times as you need.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHO IT'S FOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Commission sales

• Delivery and gig drivers

• Anyone whose income changes month to month
